backlog.title: Delta Workflow Restoration — Critical & Major (Issues 1 & 2)
backlog.description: Restore the delta-session breakdown pipeline so that newly-added PRD requirements are decomposed into tasks. Issue 1 (Critical): reorder decomposePRD() so the delta branch over delta_prd.md runs before the hasBacklog early-return guard. Issue 2 (Major): remove the silent drop of 'added' requirements in patchBacklog and implement handling for the integrate-into-current-session path.

milestones.title: Restore Delta-Session Breakdown Reachability (Issue 1 — CRITICAL)
milestones.description: Make decomposePRD() always run the architect breakdown over delta_prd.md for delta sessions, regardless of the pre-existing patched backlog. Merge the decomposed tasks with the patched backlog statuses.

tasks.title: Reorder decomposePRD() delta branch above hasBacklog guard and merge results
tasks.description: Restructure decomposePRD() in src/workflows/prp-pipeline.ts so that the isDelta detection + loadDeltaPRD() call occurs BEFORE the hasBacklog early-return guard. For delta sessions, always proceed to the architect breakdown over delta_prd.md, then merge the architect-generated tasks with the existing patched backlog.

subtasks.title: Reorder decomposePRD() to check isDelta before hasBacklog early-return
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/008_15504f60a0ef/bugfix/001_9a4fd2467e1a/architecture/delta_workflow.md — decomposePRD() at src/workflows/prp-pipeline.ts:~1100 has hasBacklog early-return BEFORE the isDelta branch. spawnDeltaSession() (line ~963) step 7 saves non-empty patchedBacklog to the delta session before decomposePRD() runs, making hasBacklog always true. The isDelta/loadDeltaPRD branch (line ~1155) is dead code in production.
2. INPUT: The method decomposePRD() in PRPPipeline (src/workflows/prp-pipeline.ts:~1100). Current flow: check hasBacklog → early-return if true → THEN check isDelta. Available helpers: loadDeltaPRD(sessionPath) from session-utils.ts:1480, isDelta = currentSession.metadata.parentSession != null.
3. LOGIC: Reorder the control flow in decomposePRD(): (a) FIRST compute isDelta = this.sessionManager.currentSession?.metadata.parentSession != null. (b) If isDelta is true, skip the hasBacklog check entirely and proceed to load delta_prd.md via loadDeltaPRD(sessionPath), create the architect agent, and call architectAgent.prompt(createArchitectPrompt(prdContent, sessionPath)). (c) If isDelta is false, keep the ORIGINAL hasBacklog early-return logic unchanged (non-delta sessions with existing backlogs still skip). (d) Read the architect's output from tasks.json via readFile(sessionPath/tasks.json). Do NOT remove the missing-delta_prd.md error handling (the try/catch around loadDeltaPRD that throws a clear error). Mock createArchitectAgent and createArchitectPrompt for isolation.
4. OUTPUT: decomposePRD() invokes the architect over delta_prd.md content for delta sessions and reaches the task-parsing code (readFile of tasks.json at line ~1195), enabling P1.M1.T1.S2 (merge logic) to run. The method signature is unchanged: async decomposePRD(): Promise<void>.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Update JSDoc on decomposePRD() (src/workflows/prp-pipeline.ts) to document that delta sessions always run the breakdown over delta_prd.md regardless of pre-existing backlog.

subtasks.title: Implement backlog merge: merge architect-decomposed tasks with patched backlog statuses
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See architecture/delta_workflow.md §Fix Strategy Approach A. The patched backlog (from spawnDeltaSession step 5, saved in step 7) already has modified→Planned and removed→Obsolete applied. The architect, invoked over delta_prd.md (which contains only Added/Modified/Removed sections + patch instructions), will generate a fresh partial backlog for the added requirements. These need to be merged.
2. INPUT: Two Backlog objects: (a) patchedBacklog = this.sessionManager.currentSession?.taskRegistry (the non-empty pre-patched backlog with modified→Planned, removed→Obsolete already applied — from P1.M1.T1.S1's reordered flow, this is available at the start of decomposePRD for delta sessions). (b) architectBacklog = the backlog parsed from the architect's tasks.json output (parsed at line ~1198 as parsedBacklog). The renderDeltaPRD format (session-utils.ts:1386) includes '## Added' sections that the architect decomposes.
3. LOGIC: Implement a merge function that: (a) Takes patchedBacklog as the base. (b) For each Phase in architectBacklog: if a Phase with the same title exists in patchedBacklog, merge new Milestones/Tasks into it (append tasks to matching milestones, create new milestones if needed). If the Phase doesn't exist, append it to patchedBacklog.backlog[]. (c) De-duplicate by checking existing task IDs to avoid duplicates (the patched backlog has existing IDs like P1.M1.T1.S1; architect output for added requirements should produce new IDs that don't collide). (d) Save the merged backlog via this.sessionManager.saveBacklog(mergedBacklog). Keep the existing totalTasks/currentPhase updates. Mock the architect agent and session manager for unit isolation.
4. OUTPUT: The merged Backlog is saved to the delta session's tasks.json via saveBacklog(). decomposePRD() sets this.currentPhase = 'prd_decomposed' and this.totalTasks = this.#countTasks() on the merged backlog. Consumed by the pipeline's run() method which proceeds to executeBacklog().
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Add JSDoc to the new merge function explaining that it combines architect-generated tasks for added requirements with the patched backlog (modified/removed already handled).

milestones.title: Make executeBacklog Abort on Empty Backlog (Issue 5)
milestones.description: Ensure executeBacklog() throws when no backlog is found, so the pipeline does not silently proceed to validation/QA with zero tasks.

tasks.title: Make 'no backlog found' a hard abort that propagates unconditionally
tasks.description: Move the no-backlog check above the try/catch in executeBacklog, or throw a fatal PipelineError that propagates past isFatalError().

subtasks.title: Move no-backlog check above try/catch and throw fatal error
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See architecture/test_validation.md §Issue 5. executeBacklog() at src/workflows/prp-pipeline.ts:~1295 throws Error('Cannot execute pipeline: no backlog found in session') INSIDE the try/catch block. isFatalError() (src/utils/errors.ts:~835) returns false for plain Error (only PipelineError subtypes like SessionError+LOAD_FAILED are fatal). The catch swallows it and continues. When continueOnError=true, isFatalError ALWAYS returns false (override at line ~842), so even a fatal error would be swallowed.
2. INPUT: executeBacklog() method in src/workflows/prp-pipeline.ts:~1295. The skipExecutionLoop guard (line ~1305) is above the try block. Available error classes from src/utils/errors.ts: SessionError (fatal with LOAD_FAILED/SAVE_FAILED codes), ErrorCodes enum.
3. LOGIC: Move the backlog null-check and the 'Cannot execute pipeline: no backlog found' throw ABOVE the try/catch block (between the skipExecutionLoop early-return and the try). This ensures the throw propagates unconditionally — it is NOT caught by the try/catch's isFatalError check, so it works even under --continue-on-error. Alternatively, throw new SessionError('Cannot execute pipeline: no backlog found in session', ErrorCodes.PIPELINE_SESSION_LOAD_FAILED, { operation: 'executeBacklog' }) instead of plain Error — but MOVING the check above try/catch is the safer fix since it bypasses isFatalError entirely. Keep the rest of executeBacklog (subtask count check, progress tracker, execution loop) inside the try/catch.
4. OUTPUT: executeBacklog() throws when no backlog is found, and the throw propagates to the caller (run()'s catch or the pipeline abort). The pipeline does NOT proceed to validation/QA with zero tasks.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Update JSDoc on executeBacklog() to document that a missing backlog causes an unconditional abort (not subject to continue-on-error).

The main session numbering pattern (session-utils.ts/session-manager.ts) uses String(sequence).padStart(3, '0') for NNN and a 12-char hash: 'NNN_hash' e.g. '001_14b9dc2a33c7'. The bugfix numbering should mirror this under the bugfix/ subdirectory. Currently runQACycle uses resolve(sessionPath, 'bugfix') (flat, line ~1730).

LOGIC: Create a helper function (in session-utils.ts or prp-pipeline.ts) nextBugfixDir(sessionPath: string, hashSeed: string): { dir: string, sequence: number } that: (a) Reads sessionPath/bugfix/ directory listing (catch ENOENT → empty array, meaning first iteration). (b) Extracts sequence numbers from entries matching /^\d{3}_/. (c) Returns next sequence = max(found) + 1, or 1 if none found. (d) Constructs dir = resolve(sessionPath, 'bugfix', `${String(seq).padStart(3, '0')}_${hash}`). (e) The hash can be derived from the bug report content hash or a timestamp-based hash for uniqueness. Return the path. Mock filesystem for unit tests.

subtasks.title: Update #detectInterruptedBugfix() to scan numbered bugfix/ children
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See architecture/bugfix_numbering.md. #detectInterruptedBugfix() at src/workflows/prp-pipeline.ts:~1913 currently checks resolve(sessionPath, 'bugfix') (flat) for: TEST_RESULTS.md existence, tasks.json missing/empty/corrupt. It returns the flat bugfixDir if interrupted, null if healthy. With numbered dirs, it must scan ALL children of sessionPath/bugfix/ and find the most recent interrupted one.
2. INPUT: sessionPath (main session dir). The nextBugfixDir helper from P3.M1.T1.S1 (for reading the bugfix/ listing). readdir from node:fs/promises. The existing interrupted-state detection logic (TEST_RESULTS.md present + tasks.json missing/empty/invalid-JSON/invalid-BacklogSchema).
3. LOGIC: Rewrite #detectInterruptedBugfix() to: (a) Read sessionPath/bugfix/ directory (catch ENOENT → return null, no bugfix dir). (b) Filter entries matching /^\d{3}_/ (numbered children only). (c) Sort by sequence number descending (most recent first). (d) For each numbered child dir: apply the EXISTING interrupted-state checks (TEST_RESULTS.md exists → tasks.json missing/empty/corrupt-JSON/invalid-Backlog → return this dir as interrupted). (e) If a child has a valid tasks.json (healthy/completed), SKIP it and continue to older children. (f) Return the FIRST interrupted child found (most recent), or null if none interrupted. Use BacklogReadSchema (from P2.M2.T1.S1) instead of BacklogSchema for the Backlog validation check (so lenient read semantics apply here too). Mock filesystem for unit tests.
4. OUTPUT: #detectInterruptedBugfix() returns the path to the most recent interrupted numbered bugfix dir, or null. Resume-interrupted-breakdown works across multiple iterations. Prior completed iterations are skipped.
